sections.title: Habit and leaves
sections.text: The catalogue entry Castanea refers to Castanea sativa, the European sweet chestnut, a large deciduous tree that can reach about 35 m. Its lance-shaped, toothed leaves are about 16–28 cm long; flowering catkins may reach 10–20 cm.

sections.title: Chestnuts and distinction
sections.text: The fruits are enclosed in a very spiny husk; sweet chestnuts are edible and are eaten cooked or ground into flour. They must not be confused with horse-chestnut seeds, which are inedible and toxic. The plate matches sweet chestnut and shows its spiny husks.
